posts.author: Dr. Anil Sharma
posts.tipTitle: 💡 Soil pH matters more than you think
posts.tipBody: A soil pH between 6.2 and 7.0 maximises nutrient availability. Test your soil before every season — it is the single most important thing you can do for your crops.

posts.tipTitle: 🌱 Biological seed treatment: Why it matters
posts.tipBody: Seed priming with beneficial microbes establishes a healthy root microbiome from the very first day. A strong start leads to stronger crops throughout the season.
